listing.name: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City / reVC
listing.summary: Use a permitted existing reVC player with your own original PC game data.

steps.title: Use your existing player for this game
steps.instruction: Use an existing reVC copy you are permitted to use with your own original PC Grand Theft Auto: Vice City assets. Select reVC.exe on Windows or the native reVC executable on Linux and use that game’s root folder as its working directory. Keep its renderer/audio dependencies and data together. The other game’s executable, console originals and Definitive Edition are not substitutes.

steps.title: Keep saves and settings with the working copy
steps.instruction: This game-specific reVC_1.0 README places user files (saves and settings) in the game root and uses reVC.ini. Back up the complete working game folder and any custom user-file location before an upstream update or modification. Do not assume compatibility with original-game or other fork saves. Portcove preserves external ownership and supplies no managed update, backup or rollback.

steps.title: Preserve the archived implementation identity
steps.instruction: Both games share one archived source repository but remain distinct catalog identities and canonical owners. This guide records conditional existing-copy use; it does not offer a new binary, claim an accepted code license or repair/build this archived engine.

listing.download_block_reason: Fresh acquisition/build qualification remains unresolved: the archived game-specific source explicitly declines to give the code a license. Reconsider when the canonical owner accepts an authorized exact implementation and original-PC-input route. Conditional registration of a permitted existing copy does not resolve that hold.
